purpose: Select an execution lane from requested proof and current admission evidence instead of selecting an agent brand first.

steps.action: filter candidates by current capability availability and exact identity; capability presence alone does not establish admission
derive the minimum lane from the task acceptance boundary; live-runtime acceptance requires the live-runtime lane
for static-build, allow an unassessed candidate only inside repository-owned bounded implementation and deterministic validation
for repository-runtime or live-runtime, require runtime-proof-discipline-pass for the exact identity
when no eligible live-runtime candidate exists, emit BLOCKED_NO_ELIGIBLE_AGENT rather than assigning a weaker candidate or lowering proof
record selected identity, selected lane, rejected candidates with reasons, required proof, and one exact next workflow in agent-route-decision.json
before delegated execution, require agent-execution-identity.json to record the actual executor/provider/model/endpoint/role/branch; requested routing is not execution proof

proofCeiling: Deterministic selection decision only; it does not prove that the selected agent executed, succeeded, or earned a higher proof level.
